FAQs

Experts Answers

Everything you need to know, before stepping into the spotlight.

A full-service trade show marketing agency designs, produces and manages brand experiences for exhibitions and trade shows. From 3D stand design and graphic production to on-site project management, AV, staffing and activations, every detail is carefully engineered so brands can perform at their best on the show floor.

Yes. Iventions is a trade show marketing company with an in-house design and production team. This integrated setup allows full control over quality, timelines and budgets from concept to delivery, keeping the process seamless, efficient and stress-free.

Yes. While based in Barcelona and London, Iventions delivers projects across Europe. With experience in major exhibition venues, trusted local suppliers and a multilingual team with global know-how, international trade shows are managed smoothly and confidently from start to finish.

Iventions provides a complete end-to-end service covering 3D exhibition stand design, graphic design and branding, stand production and build, audiovisual and technical solutions, hosts and brand ambassadors, interactive activations, logistics, installation, dismantling and on-site project management. All services are integrated under one trade show marketing company to ensure consistency, clarity and quality throughout the project.

Iventions combines strategic thinking, creative design and flawless execution. With in-house capabilities, international experience and a true partnership mindset, the team helps brands stand out, perform and stay memorable at trade shows across Europe.
